skill.name: appllama-app-design-skill
skill.description: Design and implement polished Expo and React Native screens using platform conventions, native controls, purposeful motion, performance checks, and simulator-based verification.
skill.summary: Build polished mobile interfaces that feel native on iOS and Android.
skill.author: appllama

content.value_statement: Mobile interfaces often feel inconsistent when controls, navigation, motion, and loading states are designed separately. This skill provides one practical Expo and React Native workflow.
actual_capabilities: Guides Expo and React Native screen design using platform-native patterns.
Defines navigation choices for pushes, replacements, modals, sheets, overlays, and protected routes.
Provides motion rules for gestures, transitions, Reduce Motion, and frame-rate targets.
Covers semantic colors, typography, safe areas, native controls, and accessible tap targets.
Recommends state, list, image, and input patterns that improve perceived performance.
Supplies simulator checklists for themes, devices, navigation, motion, keyboard behavior, and edge states.
limitations: The guidance assumes Expo, React Native, TypeScript, and Expo Router unless the project already uses alternatives.
It does not replace platform documentation, accessibility audits, usability research, or testing on physical devices.
Appllama screen research requires a separate connected MCP service.
Performance targets still require release-build profiling on supported devices.

use_cases.title: Design a New Mobile Flow
use_cases.description: Create onboarding, checkout, settings, or subscription screens with suitable controls, navigation, states, and motion.

use_cases.title: Implement a Native Screen
use_cases.description: Translate product requirements into an Expo screen that follows iOS and Android interaction conventions.

use_cases.title: Audit Interface Quality
use_cases.description: Review an existing flow for navigation errors, inconsistent styling, accessibility gaps, motion problems, and performance risks.

prompt_templates.title: Design One Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a [screen type] for my [app category]. Include hierarchy, native controls, primary action, empty state, and light and dark themes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Complete Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement a [flow name] in Expo Router. Define every route, transition, back behavior, loading state, error state, and completion path.

prompt_templates.title: Polish Motion and Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React Native interaction for motion and performance. Identify measurable problems, recommend Reanimated patterns, and define simulator verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Production Experience
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the attached mobile flow against native controls, navigation semantics, accessibility, visual consistency, state architecture, motion, and release-build performance. Prioritize actionable findings.

output_examples.input: Design a subscription paywall that opens from a premium feature.
output: Present the paywall as a dismissible modal over the premium feature.
Keep purchase restoration and pricing visible without hiding the close action.
After purchase, dismiss to the original feature and show its unlocked state.

output_examples.input: Review a search screen that stutters while typing.
output: Measure commit counts and input latency before changing memoization.
Keep fast-changing text outside broad shared state.
Virtualize growing results and verify visible echo remains below 50 milliseconds.

output_examples.input: Plan final verification for an onboarding flow.
output: Record the complete flow in light and dark themes.
Test completion as a one-way navigation transition.
Check keyboard movement, Reduce Motion, long text, safe areas, and back behavior.

best_practices: Study several successful reference screens, then reuse patterns without copying branded pixels.
Measure performance before optimizing and repeat the same measurement after each change.
Verify complete flows in simulators, including motion, themes, accessibility settings, long content, and failure states.
anti_patterns: Do not replace native controls with visually similar custom components without a product requirement.
Do not use decorative gradients, mixed icon families, arbitrary radii, or inconsistent action labels by default.
Do not approve screens from static code review without running and recording the complete interaction.

faq.question: Which projects fit this skill?
faq.answer: It best fits Expo and React Native applications using TypeScript and Expo Router.

faq.question: Does it support both iOS and Android?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains shared principles and platform-specific controls, navigation, icons, back behavior, and testing.

faq.question: Does it generate production code?
faq.answer: It guides code generation and review, but output quality depends on project context, installed libraries, and verification.

faq.question: Is Appllama MCP required?
faq.answer: No. The core guidance works independently, while the MCP can provide real application screens for research.

faq.question: How does it address accessibility?
faq.answer: It covers Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, contrast, safe areas, semantic controls, and minimum tap targets.

faq.question: How should performance recommendations be verified?
faq.answer: Profile the exact interaction in a release build, change one measured cause, and repeat the same test.
